title: MySQL server or driver error text disclosed in a response
description: The response carries a MySQL or MariaDB error raised by the server or by the PHP driver: a refused connection, a dropped connection, or a driver exception class. Unlike a syntax error, these messages name the database host, the driver version and often the credentials path, so a caller learns the deployment shape without sending an injection payload.
remediation: Catch driver exceptions at the application boundary and return a generic error page with a correlation id. Disable display_errors and mysqli exception reporting in production; log the original message server-side only.
limitation: One response body. The check reads the message text; it does not confirm that the database is reachable from the network, and it cannot tell an operator-facing health page from a public one.

check.valuePattern: (?:Can't connect to (?:local )?MySQL server|mysqli_sql_exception|mysqli::__construct\(\)|MySQL server has gone away|mysql_connect\(\)\s*:)

observation.body: Can't connect to MySQL server on 'db' (111)
